purpose: Post-evaluation mathematical variability reference only; no new cases, refits, method changes, or q changes.
score_model: Frozen nonconformity score S=position_error/positive_observation_scale; iid continuous common score CDF F.
derivation: For m iid calibration scores and q=S_(k), U=F(q)~Beta(k,m+1-k). Independently conditional on U, K|U~Binomial(N,U); integrating gives K~BetaBinomial(N,k,m+1-k).
assumptions: Estimator and positive score scale frozen independently of calibration/test observations.
Calibration and coverage-test scores are iid from one common continuous CDF; no score ties under the idealized model.
Test cases are independent of calibration and one another before conditioning; only their common random q induces dependence marginally.
not_claimed: Not a confidence interval conditional on the realized calibration set.
Not a revised calibration quantile or a post-hoc change to the predictor.
Not a coverage guarantee for scenarios, rejected subsets, or distribution shift.
Does not erase the observed 85.625% coverage at nominal 90%.
Does not verify that idealized iid/continuous assumptions hold in real radio data.
